title: Trace level arsenic (III) ion detection in water with a liquid-gated rGO/GO field effect transistor based sensor
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01060H, Paper
Arijit Pattra, Bathula Satwik, Himanshu Pramod Padole, Sayan Dey
Gate voltage modulation in rGO/GO FET demonstrate a promising potential to detect As(III) ions in water having a detection limit of 0.720 ppb.
